title: 第一卷 第2423章 夏侯徳亲自出面第一卷 第2422章 萧雨还是狂的
content_zh:
;;
夏侯朗是被萧雨彻底激怒了。
萧雨这是轻视他么？
竟然妄想将他击败不成！
若真做到，那他成了什么？
废物？
只有废物才可能被人越境击败，但他夏侯朗活了这般岁月，经历战斗不计其数，每一分力量都是千锤百炼而来。
可不是样子货。
此刻，夏侯朗认真起来，神色严肃，繁石经在他的催动之下，来到了顶峰，一波波力量辐射出去，沉重至极，足够将人压成肉饼！
萧雨只感觉浑身都在疼痛，骨骼更是在重压之下吱呀作响，内脏都在裂开，要被挤压成浓水一般！
“天重轮！”
夏侯朗低吼，只见萧雨身周的大地开始翻滚起来，一块块岩石浮空，然后重重的拼凑在一起，而且不断的挤压，疯狂的浓缩。
而这个过程只在瞬间完成，下一刻，一道轮环出现，随意一个旋转，恐怖至极的重力便是作用在萧雨身上！
如此恐怖的重力笼罩之下，超越常规万倍，萧雨别说出剑了，就是动手指都做不到！
这般重力，是连神魂都运转都会变得艰难。
萧雨闷哼，体表青筋暴起，皮肤都成了绛紫色，是在费尽全力抵挡重力的侵袭。
天神多是肉身强横之辈，萧雨这等豪族子弟更是如此，不过这会儿，也有些撑不住了。
“哼！”
萧雨冷哼，天重轮的出现的确让她吃苦头，但，还没完呢。
轰！

只听一声爆响。
萧雨脚下的大地竟顿时一空，所有的岩层都被破碎开来，像是被无数纵横交错的剑狠狠斩碎。
萧雨随即下落。
在那恐怖重力加持之下，下落速度达到了匪夷所思的地步，萧雨整个人如同炮弹一般冲向地底深处。
这看着恐怕将遭受重创。
但夏侯朗却神色一变，有几分难看起来。
萧雨落下势必重创，但却也变相的逃出了他天重轮的掌控范围，这可不是夏侯朗想要看到的。
更关键的是，这并非夏侯朗自己的力量导致。
地下被清空，是萧雨的支离神术所为，她在方才出手反击的同时，便已经将支离神术的力量震入大地，为的便是以备不时之需！
不过，想要逃，可没有那么容易！
当下夏侯朗将手猛地往下一压。
天重轮轮转半圈，便是同样急速往地底之下撞击而去！
他要将地底的一切都震碎。
轰！
一声更为巨大的震响传来，大地都开始摇晃，仿佛爆发了大地震一般，方圆数百里都震感十分的明显。
这是夏侯朗这一击所致。
萧雨若是被击实了，怕是直接成为肉泥，不说会被杀死，但也将彻底失去战斗能力。
对萧雨，这样的力度倒也够了，如无必要，夏侯朗也不想将萧雨斩杀，毕竟萧家后续的反弹，力度势必不小。
“萧雨不会被砸死吧”，纪颜眨眨眼。
她的确不喜欢萧雨。

但也不喜欢这夏侯朗夏侯成，当然不想萧雨战败。
“或许没有那么简单”，谢诗莹道。
因为萧雨很多时候跟她一道，所以她对萧雨的关注也会更多，更能感知到萧雨的变化。
她觉得萧雨不会就这样被击败。
她应该又往后多布几步。

Xia Houlang was completely angered by Xiao Yu.
Is Xiao Yu looking down on him?
He actually tried to defeat him but failed!
If he did, what would he become?
waste?
Only trash can be defeated by someone crossing the border, but he, Xia Houlang, has lived for so many years and experienced countless battles, and every ounce of his strength has been tempered.
It's not a show-off.
At this moment, Xia Houlang became serious and looked serious. Under his urging, the Stone Scripture reached its peak, and waves of power radiated out. It was so heavy that it could crush a person into a meat pie!
Xiao Yu only felt pain all over her body, her bones were creaking under the heavy pressure, her internal organs were cracking, and they were about to be squeezed into thick water!
"Heavenly Wheel!"
Xia Houlang roared, and saw that the ground around Xiao Yu began to roll, and rocks floated into the air, and then they were pieced together heavily, and they were constantly squeezed and concentrated crazily.
And this process was only completed in an instant. The next moment, a wheel ring appeared and rotated at will. The terrifying gravity acted on Xiao Yu!
Under such a terrifying gravity, which is ten thousand times beyond normal, Xiao Yu can't even move his fingers, let alone a sword!
Such gravity makes it difficult for even the soul to move.
Xiao Yu groaned, veins on his body popped out, and his skin turned purple, as he tried his best to resist the invasion of gravity.
Most of the gods are physically tyrannical people, especially the children of wealthy families like Xiao Yu, but at this moment, they can no longer hold on.
"Hmph!"
Xiao Yu snorted coldly. The appearance of the Heavenly Wheel had indeed made her suffer, but it was not over yet.
boom!
Just heard a bang.
The ground under Xiao Yu's feet suddenly became empty, and all the rock formations were broken into pieces, as if they were severely chopped into pieces by countless crisscrossing swords.
Xiao Yu immediately disappeared.
Under the blessing of that terrifying gravity, the falling speed reached an incredible level, and Xiao Yu rushed towards the depths of the ground like a cannonball.
This looks like it will be severely damaged.
But Xia Houlang's expression changed, and he looked a little embarrassed.
Xiao Yuluo was bound to be severely injured, but he also escaped from the control of his Heavenly Chonglun in disguise. This was not what Xia Houlang wanted to see.
More importantly, this was not caused by Xia Houlang's own strength.
The ground was cleared because of Xiao Yu's Divine Fragmentation Technique. Just when she launched a counterattack, she had already sent the power of the Divine Fragmentation Technique into the earth to prepare for emergencies!
However, escaping is not that easy!
At that moment, Xia Houlang pressed his hand down sharply.
The Heavenly Heavy Wheel rotated half a circle and then hit the ground at the same rapid speed!
He will shatter everything under the earth to pieces.
boom!
A louder sound came, and the earth began to shake, as if a major earthquake had erupted, and the earthquake was clearly felt for hundreds of miles around.
This was caused by Xia Houlang's blow.
If Xiao Yu was hit hard, he would probably turn into flesh. Not only would he be killed, but he would also completely lose his ability to fight.
For Xiao Yu, such intensity was enough. Xia Houlang did not want to kill Xiao Yu if necessary. After all, the subsequent rebound of the Xiao family was bound to be quite powerful.
"Xiao Yu won't be smashed to death, right?" Ji Yan blinked.
She really didn't like Xiao Yu.
But he also doesn’t like Xia Hou Lang and Xia Hou Cheng, and of course he doesn’t want Xiao Yu to lose.
"Maybe it's not that simple," Xie Shiying said.
Because Xiao Yu spends a lot of time with her, she pays more attention to Xiao Yu and is more aware of Xiao Yu's changes.
She felt that Xiao Yu would not be defeated like this.
She should have taken a few more steps back.
